component.name: Ond
component.summary: Play music from a Navidrome server

description.p: Ond is a desktop player for Navidrome. It streams or downloads your library, plays gapless with ReplayGain, keeps a queue that shows where each track came from, and can check your files for fake hi-res and loudness.
A test release for installing an update from Settings.
Install an update from Settings without turning on automatic installs.
A second beta for trying an update that installs itself.
Updates that install themselves, and a choice between full releases and betas.
Local music folders, several sources at once, and an option to combine matching albums.
Generated covers, interface zoom, clearer settings and notices with Retry and Undo.
First release for Linux and Windows.
